notes.subject: קוץ
notes.rationale: 'chéirei asy' (to be disgusted) — some read 'to dread/be anxious'; KJV 'abhorrest', BSB 'dread'.

notes.subject: האדמה אשר אתה קץ
notes.rationale: Does 'you' refer to Ahaz dreading the land (Syria/Ephraim), or does he loathe it — JPS detaches 'two kings' to modify the land; ASV/BSB attach them ('land of the two kings you dread').

notes.subject: vaíre / porãvae
notes.rationale: Hebrew ra/tov are 'evil/good' in the widest sense; no single avañeʼẽ pair carries both moral and practical senses.

notes.subject: ojehejata
notes.rationale: עזב nifal can mean 'be deserted/laid waste' (BSB) rather than simply 'be abandoned'.

translation: Umíva rehe, mitã guaʼu kuaa mboyve omondyi vaíre ha oiporavo porãvape, ojehejata yvy Efráim ha Aram mburuvichakuéra mokõivévagui, pe yvy nde chéirei asy vaʼekue.
